svg.title: IFINDIT PQRS CLASSIFIER: from incoming communications to the responsible team
svg.desc: IFINDIT PQRS CLASSIFIER illustration: communications arriving by email, web form, chat and paper filing are plugged into an AI classifier. It extracts key data — filing number #48213, date, type and deadline — and files each one in the document manager, which assigns it directly to the responsible area: requests (42) to Citizen Services, complaints (18) to Internal Control, claims (27) to the Subsidies Directorate and suggestions (6) to the Planning Office, each with its response deadline. A map below places the PQRS Classifier on the Auth IAM and LakeHouse base and shows that its data feeds ChatGen and the Dashboards.

g.text: Files and assigns to the responsible team
